messages:
ReleaseBot: deploy queued: hotfix for service=embed-service image=embed:v2.3.4

Elaine: saw 18% tail latency on embeddings since 03:42 UTC, N=5k reqs. Can we fast-track this? @Srini @Maria

Srini: agree it's customer-impacting. What's the rollback criteria? Need clear threshold.

Oncall-Ops: metrics dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/r/embeds?from=now-30m — 95p up from 220ms -> 520ms. Error rate +0.8% upstream validations.

Jonathan: tagging release windows — we have 1h left in the change window. If we want to roll fully now we need expedited approvals (2 engineers + SRE). Post release notes link please.

Maria: tests green in staging, perf-run shows improved p95 locally. +1 to expedite if rollback is clear. :thumbsup: 

Elaine: propose rollback if error rate >1.5% for 3 continuous minutes OR 95p latency >600ms. Also suggest canary 5% for 10min then 25%.

Jonathan: we can accept those triggers. To skip canary we need 3 explicit approvals. Who's in?

Srini: I'm +1 to skip canary. The issue is severe and customers are affected.

ReleaseBot: `deploy --service embed-service --image embed:v2.3.4 --region eu-west1 --canary 5%` queued. Note: canary policy enforced unless overridden.

Maria: If everyone +1 we can override. +1 from me. :white_check_mark:

Elaine: +1. I'm on standby to monitor. Posting quick runbook: 
```
Action if rollback triggered:
1) run `k8s scale deploy embed-service --replicas=0 --namespace=prod-eu` to stop rollout
2) `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embed-service -n prod-eu`
3) alert customers + set incident channel
```

DevOps-Bot: Deploy bot: Canary start logged at 2026-03-23T22:40:34Z — 50 pods draining to new image (5% traffic split).

Oncall-Ops: seeing initial canary: latency trending down on 2 of 3 nodes, one node still warming. Monitoring for 10m.

Jonathan: with Srini/Maria/Elaine approvals that's 3. Proceeding to skip remainder of canary and move to 25% after 10m if stable. I'll mark expedited in release notes (link coming).

ReleaseBot: Canary check passed at +10m: error delta 0.1%, 95p improved. Rolling to 25%.

Elaine: watch the error rate. If it spikes we'll roll back immediately.

DevOps-Bot: Rollout to 25% complete. Gradual to 100% scheduled over 15m.

Maria: uploaded release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-23-embed-hotfix — includes rollback criteria and changelog.

Oncall-Ops: 25% -> 100% rollout started. No alarms so far.

ReleaseBot: Rollout complete: embed-service now on image embed:v2.3.4 in eu-west1 and eu1. Change window still OK.

Jonathan: closing thread. Thanks everyone for fast approvals. Please file post-deploy check in the release tracker.

Elaine: will follow up with perf snapshot in 1h. :rocket:
